concepts.name: Prokaryotic vs Eukaryotic Cell Structure
concepts.description: Cell wall, plasma membrane, mesosomes, inclusion bodies, membrane-bound organelles.

concepts.name: Endomembrane System & Organelles
concepts.description: ER, Golgi apparatus, Lysosomes, Vacuoles, Mitochondria, Plastids, Ribosomes (70S vs 80S).

concepts.name: Cell Cycle, Mitosis and Meiosis
concepts.description: Phases of cell cycle (G1, S, G2, M), stages of prophase I (leptotene to diakinesis), crossing over.

concepts.name: C4 Photosynthetic Pathway (Hatch-Slack)
concepts.description: Kranz anatomy, PEP carboxylase initial CO2 fixation, and OAA synthesis.

concepts.name: Mendel's Laws of Inheritance & Monohybrid Cross
concepts.description: Dominance, segregation, test cross ratio 1:1, incomplete dominance and codominance (ABO blood).

concepts.name: Dihybrid Cross, Independent Assortment & Linkage
concepts.description: Morgan's experiments on Drosophila, linkage vs recombination frequency, genetic maps.

concepts.name: Pedigree Analysis & Genetic Disorders
concepts.description: Autosomal vs sex-linked dominant/recessive traits, Hemophilia, Sickle-cell anemia, Down syndrome.

concepts.name: Gene Interaction & Non-Mendelian Epistasis
concepts.description: Recessive and dominant epistasis modifying standard dihybrid 9:3:3:1 ratios.

concepts.name: Population Ecology & Logistic Growth Model
concepts.description: Verhulst-Pearl logistic equation, carrying capacity K, and maximum growth rate at K/2.

concepts.name: Blood Components, Cardiac Cycle & ECG
concepts.description: Formed elements, blood groups, cardiac output, pacemaker action potential, P-QRS-T waves.

concepts.name: Nephron Physiology & Countercurrent Multiplier
concepts.description: Henle's loop ion transport, water permeability, and medullary osmotic gradient.

concepts.name: Kinematics & Projectile Motion
concepts.description: Equations of motion, projectile maximum height and range, vertical projectile motion under gravity.

concepts.name: Work, Kinetic Energy & Conservation of Energy
concepts.description: Work-energy theorem, potential energy of springs, conservation of mechanical energy.

concepts.name: Wheatstone Bridge & Balanced Resistance Networks
concepts.description: Null deflection condition P/Q = R/S in resistance bridges.

concepts.name: Gravitational Potential & Escape Velocity Scaling
concepts.description: Planetary escape velocity formula and mass/radius proportionality.

concepts.name: Refraction at Spherical Surfaces & Total Internal Reflection
concepts.description: Snell's Law, critical angle, optical fibers, prism formula, lens maker's formula.

concepts.name: Faraday's Law of Induction & Induced EMF
concepts.description: Time-varying magnetic flux, induced electromotive force, and Lenz's law.

concepts.name: Photoelectric Effect & Einstein's Equation
concepts.description: Photon energy, work function threshold, and maximum kinetic energy.

concepts.name: Carbohydrates, Amino Acids and Peptide Bonds
concepts.description: Reducing sugars, zwitterion, peptide linkages, alpha-helix vs beta-pleated structures, vitamins.

concepts.name: Oxides of Nitrogen & Chemical Structures
concepts.description: Preparation, oxidation states, and linear sp structure of nitrous oxide (N2O).

concepts.name: Nucleophilic Substitution Mechanisms (SN2 vs SNi)
concepts.description: Thionyl chloride with pyridine inversion vs retention stereochemistry.

concepts.name: pH Calculation, Ostwald Dilution & Buffers
concepts.description: Weak acid/base dissociation constant Ka, Ostwald's dilution law, pH calculations, common ion effect.

concepts.name: Chemical Bonding & Expanded Octet Hybridization
concepts.description: VSEPR theory, steric number, and sp3d2 octahedral geometry in SF6.

concepts.name: Standard Cell Potential & Galvanic Cell EMF
concepts.description: Standard reduction potentials, cathode minus anode EMF calculation.

prerequisites.description: Cellular compartmentalization understanding is needed for individual organelle functions.
Centrosome and chromatin structure understanding is required for chromosome separation.
Meiotic reduction division is the physical basis of Mendel's law of segregation.
Dihybrid cross and independent assortment are modified by chromosomal linkage.
Tracing inheritance modes in human families requires Mendelian and linkage principles.
Kinematics equations are fundamental to work-energy calculations.
Protein and phospholipid chemistry underpins organelle membrane structure.
